verdict.rationale: Ramp's docs describe finance teams issuing instant virtual cards for each software subscription, with per-vendor spending limits and no shared card numbers. Funds can restrict spend to allowed merchants, categories, amounts and intervals, and the agent-card guide points to Virtual Cards for subscriptions and other reusable merchant charges. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that cards are locked to a single merchant, explicit evidence that procurement requests issue vendor-specific cards (procurement docs cover intake and routing only).
